summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Frontend engineer who cares about polished, thoughtful UI — the details, the CSS, the edge cases — and about the engineering underneath it: shared component architecture, refactoring, tooling and tests. Deep specialization in i18n infrastructure as an engineering problem rather than translation: typed pipelines, static analysis in CI, grammar-aware localization. Used to working as a self-directed engineer in an async, English-speaking product team — taking things from a fuzzy idea to production and steady state.

experience.title: Experience
experience.note: Listed here are only the projects I still run today — there have been others along the way. Outside of client work I also build systems and modules for FoundryVTT, so far for my own tabletop campaigns and friends.

jobs.description: Popular guitar tablature service with a multi-million user audience. Product frontend across the whole surface — interactive UI, component architecture, experiments, tooling — plus deep ownership of the i18n platform, in an async English-speaking team.
bullets: Refactored the app's floating UI into a single useFloatingDropdown hook, replacing per-component portal boilerplate across selects, tuning editors and settings panels.
Redesigned complex product UI: drum notation with responsive mobile layout and contextual help, the AI regeneration panel, refreshed toast notifications.
Own the frontend i18n platform: ten-plus languages across hundreds of components on a unified gettext/.po workflow with type-safe codegen and grammar-aware word order.
Designed and shipped a locale-import static analyzer with auto-fix, wired into the CI of multiple services — eliminating a class of "silent English fallback" bugs.
Led subsystem refactors: centralized notification localization across hundreds of files, moved locale resolution out of a Web Worker, split translations into lazy-loaded domains.
Ran product A/B experiments end-to-end — from experiment settings and UI to asset optimization (PNG → WebP → inline SVG) and analytics.
Delivered beyond the web app: Mocha test suites for domain logic, internal MCP server features (TypeScript service code with tests), iOS/Android user-testing support.
jobs.stack: TypeScript · Preact · SSR · CSS Modules · Web Workers · gettext/.po · Mocha / Playwright

jobs.description: Fashion and beauty center. Sole developer of the website, working directly with the business owners — from fuzzy requirements to production: migrated the site to Next.js 14 + TypeScript (App Router, static export) with galleries, SEO metadata and a full 301 migration of the old URL structure; integrated online booking, gift certificates and analytics. Keep evolving and maintaining it.
jobs.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · React · SCSS · static export

jobs.description: Manufacturer of electrochemical research equipment. Sole developer of the online catalog on WordPress + WooCommerce, working directly with the manufacturer: built the cart and checkout flow, keep improving catalog UX, set up a PostCSS pipeline and a Dockerized local environment.
